name: Rajesh Kumar
text: Amazing service! My Golden Retriever Max was so anxious about grooming, but Priya made him feel so comfortable. The quality of grooming is excellent and the staff is very professional. Highly recommended!

name: Priya Singh
text: Fresh & Furry has been grooming my Persian cat Luna for over a year now. Sneha is absolutely wonderful with cats and Luna actually enjoys her grooming sessions now. The spa package is worth every rupee!

name: Amit Joshi
text: Professional, clean, and caring. Rahul did an excellent job with my German Shepherd Bruno. The facility is spotless and they use high-quality products. My dog looks and smells amazing!

name: Sushma Reddy
text: The team at Fresh & Furry is simply the best! They took such good care of my senior dog who was nervous about grooming. The attention to detail and gentle approach made all the difference. Thank you!

name: Vikram Mehta
text: Great value for money! The monthly maintenance package keeps my Beagle looking fresh all month. The staff is knowledgeable and always gives great advice on pet care. Highly satisfied!

name: Anita Sharma
text: My cats have never looked better! The cat grooming specialist Sneha is amazing. She knows exactly how to handle cats and my Persian cats are so much more comfortable now. Excellent service!
